from datetime import datetime
access_token = access['access_token']

# playlists variable from prior run might not exist; rebuild by fetching playlist library
playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlist page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
print('total playlists:', len(playlists))

# Cache song_id -> year for release_date
song_year_cache={}

def year_from_release_date(rd):
    if not rd:
        return None
    try:
        # handle ISO strings
        return datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00')).year
    except Exception:
        try:
            return int(str(rd)[:4])
        except Exception:
            return None

# Determine songs released after 2021 in all playlists
playlist_song_pairs_to_remove=[]
playlist_song_year_counts={}

for pl in playlists:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    # fetch full playlist details
    pl_detail=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    song_ids=[s['id'] for s in pl_detail.get('songs', [])]
    # unique cache fetch
    for sid in set(song_ids):
        if sid not in song_year_cache:
            song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
            song_year_cache[sid]=year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))
        y=song_year_cache[sid]
        if y is not None and y>2021:
            # add all occurrences (should be unique)
            for sid2 in song_ids:
                if sid2==sid:
                    playlist_song_pairs_to_remove.append((pid,sid))
                    # break? but if duplicates none; keep safe
            playlist_song_year_counts.setdefault(pid,0)
            playlist_song_year_counts[pid]+=1

# Deduplicate pairs just in case
playlist_song_pairs_to_remove=list(set(playlist_song_pairs_to_remove))
print('unique playlist-song pairs to remove from playlists:', len(playlist_song_pairs_to_remove))
print('by playlist count (sample):', {k:v for k,v in list(playlist_song_year_counts.items())[:10]})

# Compute library songs after 2021 (re-fetch library and filter)
library_songs=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('library page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    library_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
print('total library songs:', len(library_songs))

library_song_years={}
for s in library_songs:
    sid=s['song_id']
    if sid not in song_year_cache:
        song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        song_year_cache[sid]=year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))
    library_song_years[sid]=song_year_cache[sid]

library_song_ids_to_remove=[sid for sid,y in library_song_years.items() if y is not None and y>2021]
print('library songs to remove (year>2021):', len(library_song_ids_to_remove), sorted(library_song_ids_to_remove))

# Prepare some human-readable info
library_songs_to_remove_info=[]
for sid in sorted(library_song_ids_to_remove):
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    library_songs_to_remove_info.append((sid,song.get('title'),year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))))
print('library removal titles:', library_songs_to_remove_info)

# For playlist pairs, show sample with titles
sample_pairs=sorted(playlist_song_pairs_to_remove)[:10]
sample_info=[]
for pid,sid in sample_pairs:
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    pl_title=[p['title'] for p in playlists if p['playlist_id']==pid][0]
    sample_info.append((pid,pl_title,sid,song.get('title'),year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))))
print('sample playlist removals:', sample_info)

# Helper
def year_from_release_date(rd):
    if not rd:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00')).year
    except Exception:
        try:
            return int(str(rd)[:4])
        except Exception:

# Fetch full song library

page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    library_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

# Determine library song ids to remove (release year > 2021)
release_year_cache={}
library_remove_ids=[]
for s in library_songs:
    sid=s['song_id']
    if sid not in release_year_cache:
        song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        release_year_cache[sid]=year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))
    y=release_year_cache[sid]
    if y is not None and y>2021:
        library_remove_ids.append(sid)

library_remove_ids=sorted(set(library_remove_ids))

    if not resp:
        break

    page_index+=1

# Determine playlist-song pairs to remove where song release year > 2021

    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    pl_detail=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)

            song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
            release_year_cache[sid]=year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))

from datetime import datetime

# Re-login to Spotify to verify state
spotify_creds = [c for c in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if c['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
access2 = apis.spotify.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=spotify_creds['password'])
access_token2 = access2['access_token']


def year_from_release_date(rd):
    if not rd:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00')).year
    except Exception:
        try:
            return int(str(rd)[:4])
        except Exception:
            return None

# Fetch library songs and check any with release year > 2021
library_after=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token2, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    library_after.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

release_year_cache={}

def get_year(sid):
    if sid in release_year_cache:
        return release_year_cache[sid]
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    y=year_from_release_date(song.get('release_date'))
    release_year_cache[sid]=y
    return y

library_after_ids=[]
for s in library_after:
    sid=s['song_id']
    y=get_year(sid)
    if y is not None and y>2021:
        library_after_ids.append((sid,s.get('title'),y))

print('Library songs after removals:', len(library_after))
print('Library songs with release year > 2021 remaining:', len(library_after_ids))
print('Remaining library scoped items:', sorted(library_after_ids))

# Fetch playlists and check for scoped songs remaining
playlists_after=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token2, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    playlists_after.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

# Determine remaining scoped songs in each playlist
remaining_pairs=[]
for pl in playlists_after:
    pid=pl['playlist_id']
    pl_detail=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token2)
    for song in pl_detail.get('songs', []):
        sid=song.get('id')
        y=get_year(sid)
        if y is not None and y>2021:
            remaining_pairs.append((pid,sid,song.get('title'),y))

print('Playlists checked:', len(playlists_after))
print('Remaining scoped playlist songs (>2021):', len(remaining_pairs))
print('Remaining pairs sample:', sorted(remaining_pairs)[:20])
